relevant_files.summary: Payroll UI owns snapshot selection, matrix tab, component status display, and existing Input Beras action.
Reusable dialog pattern for preview, dry-run/execute, headful/headless, SSE log streaming.
Builds payroll automation payloads, contains beras shortfall logic and duplicate/existing ADTRANS filtering.
Owns payroll automation routes and beras prepare/run endpoints using payroll-runner and payroll-dry-runner.
Template for AD Lists input with charge job dimensions parsed from employee.chargeJob.
Validates one DocID per component payload; currently requires chargeJob only for beras.
Maps lembur to AL0019 and builds component diff payloads, but generic automation uses full Venus amount.
Produces sync.lembur Venus vs Millware amounts and snapshot-compatible payroll result shape.

patterns.description: Beras computes inputAmount = max(0, Venus - Millware), overrides component.venusAmount to the shortfall, previews rows, supports dry-run and execute.
UI passes { source, snapshotId }; backend builds payrollSource and fetchPayrollData uses snapshot/live accordingly.
Template navigates to AD Lists, selects employee and task code, parses chargeJob, fills CBOBox indexes 2, 3, 4, then amount/add/save.

constraints: Adjustment must be available only when payrollSource is snapshot and matrix view is active.
Only Venus > Millware lembur should be included; Millware >= Venus is not an allowance top-up.
AL0019 must be used as the ADCode for TUNJANGAN LEMBUR.
Charge job is required because AD Lists dimension input depends on employee.chargeJob.
Generic payroll automation already supports lembur but inputs full Venus amount, so it is not safe for adjustment shortfall.
key_findings: Matrix currently marks lembur as Info/syncable false, so a new adjustment button should not simply reuse matrix sync buttons without changing intent.
Beras implementation is the closest pattern, including prepare endpoint, run endpoint, preview dialog, dry-run validation, data file, template, and duplicate/existing filters.
Snapshot payroll payload preserves employee.chargeJob and sync.lembur, making shortfall calculation possible from snapshot without calling Venus again.
